_HOW_TO_USE: 1) Copy this file. 2) Rename it to the partner's code, e.g. EA-9X4KQ72M.json (use a random 8-char code, never a guessable name). 3) Fill partner details. 4) Add one object in 'referrals' per referral. 5) git push. Share link: https://elevateaura.co.in/partner-portal.html?code=EA-9X4KQ72M
_STAGES: introduced | first-call | demo | proposal | signed | delivered | not-closed
_RULES: shareAmount is auto-calculated as projectValue x sharePercent unless you set shareAmount explicitly. paidAmount is cumulative amount paid so far to the partner for that referral.
